stem: Which excerpt from the U.S. Constitution best illustrates the principle of popular sovereignty?

options.label: F
options.text: “Each House shall be the Judge of the Elections, Returns and Qualifications of its own Members. . . .”

options.label: G
options.text: “The House of Representatives shall be composed of Members chosen every second Year by the People of the several States. . . .”

options.label: H
options.text: “The Senate shall chuse their other Officers, and also a President pro tempore. . . .”

options.label: J
options.text: “The Times, Places and Manner of holding Elections for Senators and Representatives, shall be prescribed in each State by the Legislature thereof.”
